activity_summary: Walking back from Hewlands you came by the end of the burned row and did not go up it. At a malt-house door two men had their hands in a bushel of thin barley, and neither would let go of his side of it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the picture, and did not go up the row.

facets.activity: Saw two men at a bushel and walked on home
